history.title: 济南年鉴1990：四门塔611年建成

site_recommendation.material: 灰白石块与局部灰褐风化，石顶灰白，门框内红色木门与暗室凹部；保持浅色石身，不统一染青。
site_recommendation.lineDetail: Landscape 1536x1024. Exactly ONE square stone chamber, ONE arched door on each of four sides, TWO visible doors in the reference three-quarter angle. Low stone slab pyramidal roof with stepped cornice and short finial. Keep the simple massive Sui stone block structure and complete base. NOT a multistorey pagoda, NOT the Buddha inside.
site_recommendation.lede: 没有层层楼阁，只有四面券门与一座石砌攒尖顶。四门塔以简洁而厚重的塔室，把隋代石建筑的轮廓留到今天。
facts: 年代依据 塔顶内部发现“大业七年造”题记，对应611年；塔内东魏造像早于塔体，不混为同一年。
形制 单层亭阁式石塔，平面正方，四面辟门，塔心柱面向四方安置佛像。
图版范围 绘整座石塔外观，塔内佛像不作为独立放大主体。

Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER only: match its delicate, elegant, sparse black contours and restrained internal detail. Image 2 and any following photographs are SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Draw the actual named structure; do not copy the Buddha shape from the style master.
Make one complete BLACK INK contour drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. All blank surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white. Thin confident organic contours, sparse selective roof and ornament detail. No grey shading, solid black door/window fills, hatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, halo, cast shadow, checkerboard, frame, labels, lettering or watermark. Plaques remain blank. Remove trees, tourists, vehicles, wires, incense burners, signs, sky and neighboring buildings. Preserve the source's identifying architecture; do not invent hidden buildings.
Centered approximately facade-level near-frontal view, verticals vertical, minimal perspective, complete apex/roof corners and base with balanced generous margins. A few short ground lines only. Landscape 1536×1024 unless specified portrait; subject fills approximately 82% of the useful axis.
